faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Camera Hot Shoe Mount suitable for Camera accessory hot shoe mounting plate?
faq.a: Titanium Camera Hot Shoe Mount uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address camera hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Camera Hot Shoe Mount?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Camera Hot Shoe Mount is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for camera accessory hot requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Camera Hot Shoe Mount require any post-machining surface treatment?
